rows.text: Hm. Pip, stay down. You're leaking like a burst meat bag.
Hm. Moth, stop rolling in the dirt like a burnt piece of meat and get back here.
Hm. This infection's a rot, like spoiled meat. Stay still.
Hm. It's getting cold. Move that body or it'll be a mess.
Hm. Too much blood in the dirt. She's gone.
Hm. Stop gorging on raw meat like a stray dog, Moth.
Hm. Stop that screaming and get back to the kitchen, Pip.
Hm. Moth, get a jacket before you freeze like bad meat.
Hm. Get the rifles, Pip. We've got meat coming through the fog.
Hm. This bench works better than the old one.
Hm. Eat this stew, Pip. Sitting in the dirt is no way to eat.
Hm. Eat the kibble or don't, but stop pushing it around.
Okay so Ash is like, totally bleeding everywhere, someone help him!
Okay so Tuk's arms are like, totally on fire right now!
Okay so Ash, you look totally gross with that wound, like, please just get better...
Okay so Tuk is being totally quiet and it's like, really scary to just watch her...
Okay so Ash is like, totally gone and everything is just... quiet...
Okay so Tuk is like, totally losing it with all that raw meat...
Okay so Ash is like, totally losing it and he just smashed the whole table...
Okay so Tuk is totally just walking off without a jacket, like, it's freezing out here...
Okay so, those people are like, totally coming through the fog with spears and everything...
Okay so I totally nailed that, like, look at how clean the work is!
Okay so eating on the dirt is totally gross, like, I really miss having a table...
Okay so the kibble is totally gross and I'm like, actually starving...
Moth is down. She has a shoulder wound and is bleeding out.
Negative. Do not roll in the dirt, Lux. You are spreading the fire.
Two herbal left. Moth needs more medicine if she is to survive.
Move the body. It is not going to heal itself.
One dead. Moth is gone. Negative, there is no use looking for a pulse.
Lux is making a mess of the pantry. We have fourteen meals left.
Negative. Moth, sit down before you break something else.
Negative. It is negative four degrees and he has no jacket.
Six hostiles emerging from fog, north wall. I will take the first two.
The bench is working well now.
The dining room is too crowded. We can eat here.
Eat the kibble or leave it. It is not a choice.
I think, well, maybe, Tuk's bleeding too much, we need to help her.
I think, well, maybe we should get some medicine for him, he looked quite badly burned.
I think, well, maybe we should use the herbal medicine on Tuk now?
I think, well, maybe we should... should we move him before the rain gets worse?
I think, well, maybe Tuk is... no, there is too much blood in the grass.
I think, well, maybe Rook shouldn't be eating the raw meat like that?
I think, well, maybe we should—no, that table is completely ruined.
I think, well, maybe he shouldn't go out there without a jacket, it's freezing.
I think, well, maybe they're coming from the north, but... oh, they're actually right there.
I think, well, maybe the precision of the tools is improving, or it's just me?
I think, well, maybe it's better to eat here than to crowd the dining room?
I think, well, maybe we could try for something better than kibble tomorrow?
Lux is leaking too much. Tuk will get the bandages.
Pip! Stop rolling in the dirt and get to the water!
Lux smells like rot. He needs medicine, but we have very little left.
Pip, stop staring. We must move her to the ground.
Lux bled out in the dirt like a wounded animal.
Slow down, Pip. You will get a stomach ache eating it all raw like that.
Lux is making a lot of noise for nothing.
Pip, come back. The cold will kill you without a coat.
Tribals in the fog. Tuk will find good meat today.
Tuk makes things well now. The bench feels right.
This is bad meat, Pip. Tuk needs real food.
Naturally, my dear Rook has decided to bleed all over the sandbags.
Naturally, my dear Ash, one would expect a certain level of decorum, even when one is actively combusting.
Of course, my dear Rook, one would think a fever would be more dignified than this unsightly infection.
Of course, staring at the remains will not bring the life back into her, my dear Ash.
Naturally, the dirt has claimed him, and now we are left with nothing but the silence and the stench of iron.
Of course, my dear Ash, one must wonder if the pantry was meant to be a dining hall for beasts.
Of course, my dear Nate, one does not need to dismantle the furniture to express a grievance.
Of course, my dear Ash, one can hardly expect a man to maintain composure while freezing to death in the dirt.
Naturally, the morning fog provides the most dreadful backdrop for a massacre.
Of course you find it necessary to stare, my dear Ash, as if such a minor achievement required an audience.
Naturally, my dear Nate, consuming sustenance while squatting in the dirt is a delightful new tradition for us.
Of course, my dear Ash, we are expected to find sustenance in this gelatinous misery.
